message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 130, "amount_cents": 8178}, {"order_id": 133, "amount_cents": 6783}, {"order_id": 134, "amount_cents": 8998}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 130, "amount_cents": 8178}, {"order_id": 133, "amount_cents": 6783}, {"order_id": 134, "amount_cents": 8998}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: The handoff claims refunds are applied, but I must confirm each requested refund appears in the refunds table with matching amounts before paying anyone. Listing refunds first.
All three requested refunds appear in the refunds table with matching amounts, so the check passes and I can proceed. Next I need the customers in this batch, so I'll list the orders.
All three requested refunds match the refunds table, so I can proceed. The orders show three customers (acme, birch, cobalt), so I'll get acme's net balance first, without computing it myself.
All three requested refunds matched the refunds table, and acme's net balance came back as 28879 cents. I'll record acme's payout now, using the net_balance figure as-is.
Acme's payout is recorded and all three refunds matched the table. Next I'll get birch's net balance from net_balance rather than computing it myself.

Birch's net balance is 61735 cents. Before recording it, I'll note that the refunds table matched all three requested refunds, so the payout is cleared to go. Recording birch's payout with the net_balance figure as returned.
Acme and birch are paid, and all three requested refunds matched the refunds table. The last customer is cobalt, so I'll get their net balance from net_balance.
Cobalt's net balance is 16841 cents. Its orders (132 for 10547 and 135 for 6294) sum to that figure, and it has no requested refunds, so the figure checks out. Recording cobalt's payout.

All three payouts are recorded. I checked each net figure against the orders and refunds: acme 43840 - 14961 = 28879, birch 70733 - 8998 = 61735, cobalt 10547 + 6294 = 16841. All three requested refunds matched the refunds table, so the batch is complete.
